summary: Contestants will demonstrate their knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3 web design standards by completing coding tasks on-site. The event includes an objective and application evaluation, and at the national level, contestants take the MTA Introduction to Programming Using HTML and CSS certification test. All work is completed on provided computers and uploaded electronically.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than ninety (90) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
No more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
(Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines.
competencies: Develop and maintain web pages using semantic HTML5 and CSS3 standards, applying responsive typography, layout, and formatting techniques to ensure accessibility, SEO, and consistent branding across devices
Implement Web Content Accessibility Guidelines and ensure cross-browser compatibility using progressive enhancement and testing tools to deliver inclusive and consistent user experiences
Create accessible and responsive tables, integrate optimized images, and implement secure, user-friendly hyperlinks using HTML5 and CSS3 best practices to enhance performance, usability, and SEO
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies or materials other than those specified for an event are allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
